scripts.audit: bun run build:site && blume audit --fail-on error
scripts.build: bun run build:site && blume audit --fail-on error
scripts.eval: bun run generate && blume eval --agent claude
scripts.generate: bun run generate:openapi && bun run generate:skills
scripts.lint: biome check blume.config.ts lib middleware.ts scripts styles vercel.json package.json turbo.json tsconfig.json tsconfig.typecheck.json
scripts.typecheck: bun run generate && blume check --strict && blume validate --strict
